rung_purposes.purpose: Load default pressure setpoints and limits into data registers on every scan
Detect PT-2001 pressure sensor wire break if reading falls below -500 (-5.00 kPa)
Latch overpressure alarm M291 when pack pressure exceeds threshold D123
Latch low supply air alarm M293 if supply pressure switch X22 drops while busy
Reset latched alarms upon pressing fault reset button X1
Evaluate summary fault M299 and drive ST20 fault beacon Y25 on alarm or tripped E-stop
Control manual vent valve Y22 via pushbutton X25 in manual mode
Start ST20 test cycle and transition to clamp step M201 when pallet arrives in auto mode
Transition from clamp step M201 to fill step M202 once clamp closed switch confirms
Run fill timeout timer T21 during fill step M202
Latch fill timeout alarm M290 if timer T21 expires
Transition from fill step M202 to stabilise step M203 once target pressure is reached
Run stabilisation timer T22 during stabilise step M203
Capture initial test pressure D110 upon timer T23 done (logic flaw: should trigger on step start)
Transition from stabilise step M203 to test step M204 when stabilisation timer T22 expires
Run test window timer T23 during test step M204
Sample final pressure D111 and calculate pressure decay D112 when test timer T23 expires
Evaluate leak test decay against limit D120 and set PASS (M210) or FAIL (M211)
Transition from test step M204 to vent step M205 when test timer T23 expires
Abort active test cycle to vent step M205 and flag failure on summary fault M299
Run vent timer T200 during vent step M205
Transition from vent step M205 to unclamp step M206 once vented and timer T200 done
Transition from unclamp step M206 to complete step M207 once clamp open switch confirms
Clear cycle complete step M207 and busy flag M200 once pallet departs
Energize clamp close solenoid Y20 during clamping, testing, and venting steps
Energize fill valve Y21 during fill step M202 if no fault is active
Open vent valve Y22 during vent step M205 or on overpressure alarm M291
Signal PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) to line controller during cycle complete step M207
End of ladder program execution
